name: h5_vs_h1_early_windows
written: 2026-10-16, before any fit or backtest on these windows
hypothesis: The 5-day training label (adopted on 2018-2025 walk-forward windows) beats the 1-day label on earlier, never-tested walk-forward windows.
settings: fast_fit.py (Alpha158, Qlib-default processing and LightGBM params, purge qlib), 7 seeds, book_eval.py --tradable --tie-draws 4, continuous simulation over each universe's windows
rule: Report the paired NW t of daily after-cost excess (h5 - h1) per universe and pooled over the common days (cross_universe.py). Replicates if the pooled t > 0 and the IR difference is positive in both universes; refuted if the pooled t < -2. No other book or window is consulted.
